 Clarity closed a $4.4 million seed round, backed by LMnT Ventures. Other investors include Regeneration VC, Humba Ventures, and Massive Technology Ventures.

Q: How does Clarity Systems' technology work?

 Clarity's technology combines diagnostic-grade X-ray intelligence with computer vision and AI to see inside the actual product, without opening the box; comparing each returned item against its original manufacturer profile and detecting counterfeits, component swaps, and product manipulation that manual inspection routinely misses.

Q: How big is the problem Clarity Systems is solving?

 According to Appriss Retail and Deloitte, returns fraud cost retailers $103 billion in 2024 and amounted to 15% of all returns.

# Clarity Systems Closes Seed Round Led by LMnT Ventures to Tackle Returns Fraud

Clarity Systems Closes Seed Round Led by LMnT Ventures to Tackle Returns Fraud

AI-powered scanning technology helps retailers detect return fraud in three seconds without opening the box

Clarity Systems, a retail fraud detection company, today announced the close of a $4.4 million seed round backed by LMnT Ventures, with participation from Regeneration VC, Humba Ventures, and Massive Technology Ventures. The Company’s system sees inside returned and received products in three seconds without having to manually open them - catching counterfeits, product swaps, and manipulation by comparing items or potential fraudulent items against the original manufacturer profile. [...] Clarity Systems was founded by Andy Ruben, Darrell Whitelaw and Sender Shamiss, seasoned veterans of the retail and returns industry, who recognized the immediate need for market changing innovation to address returns fraud, which continues to be one of retail's fastest-growing challenges. Within the year, Clarity has already signed on major national retailers in their returns and receiving operations. [...] Jeff Miller, Founder and Managing Partner of LMnT Ventures, said: “Return fraud is a stubborn, massive problem hiding in plain sight, costing the world’s largest brands billions and ultimately leaving everyday consumers to foot the bill. And it’s a problem that the founders, each with extensive experience in the retail and returns world have had to endure for decades. With Clarity’s advanced imaging hardware and proprietary AI models, this chronic problem is finally tractable. Importantly, this isn’t AI theory- it’s already happening on Clarity systems. This is a problem whose time has come and this is the team to crack it.”
